To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the current distribution in a superconductor joint can be measured using Hall probes attached on the joint block and that the measured result is consistent to a current transfer model in superconducting joints.
the current sharing in superconducting joints can be measured and the current transfer in the joint can be explained by the proposed model.

1) A new method of experimental study of current sharing in a superconductor joint was developed and used to study the current sharing in a joint between two NbTi strands; 2) The experimental result of current sharing in the superconducting joint is consistent with the current transfer model; 3) A new method to measure the critical current of superconductor joint has been developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fundamental study of current transfer in the joint.
the fundamental study of current transfer in the joint of superconducting magnets.
the study of the current distribution and current transfer in superconductors joint.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the current sharing in joint is determined by the current transfer from one superconductor to the other, and the current transfer in the joint is determined by two mechanisms, namely, (1) the flux jump in one superconductor, and (2) the magnetic flux diffusion between the two superconductors in the joint.
the current transfer in a joint is a function of the joint current, the joint width and the critical current of the joint.
the current transfer is the main mechanism for the joint.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method to investigate the current transfer and the current sharing in superconducting joints, which can be applied to the design and development of superconducting joints.
the current transfer in the joint is not a linear process and the current transfer is not uniform along the length of the joint.
the joint block has a significant effect on current transfer in the joint and the current transfer is a function of the block size, the current level, and the temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can now measure current sharing in the joints of a magnet, which is important for understanding the magnet performance and for developing a model for current sharing in the magnet.
the current sharing and transfer model can be applied to the design of a superconducting joint.
the superconducting joint can transfer current to a normal joint.
